newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Gilts ready to break higher, target 113-16.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Gilts ready to break higher, target 113-16.

text.p: LIFFE September gilt futures are well-supported and set to target the upside at 113-16, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
"Gilts have completed a triangle consolidation formation, and it's ready to resolve itself," said a technical analyst at a European bank here.
"The top of the triangle is at 113-00,02 and a break above there targets 113-16."
Marc Ostwald, technical analyst at London Bond Broking here said a break through a chart congestion area above 113-01 was likely to spark a move sharply higher.
"The market is looking quite well-supported at the moment in terms of the way the technicals are looking and is helped by sterling as well," Ostwald said.
"It's also helped by the fact it's not continental Europe."
He said if there was a failure to reach 113-16, a low on May 20, any setback would not go very far. Ostwald pegged initial support at Monday's low of 112-21.
The first technical analyst put steady support at 112-16, the middle of the noted triangle formation.
"The whole corrective move we had last week was enough for people to want to move back up now," Ostwald said.

Analysts also said 113-16 was a 50 percent retracement of the May losses on the contract and above that the next target was 113-30, but they said the market would probably not have enough momentum to conquer that in the near term.
"There's not a lot of resistance until we get up to 113-30, but I don't think we'll quite get there today because we'd need a piece of really good news to push it through those levels," Ostwald said.
Some analysts placed 114-00 as a further resistance level, but said the contract would struggle to defeat it.
